name: Foxsemicon Integrated Technology Inc.
summary: Foxsemicon Integrated Technology Inc. operates as an integrated semiconductor equipment manufacturers in the semiconductor industry. It engages in research, development, design, manufacturing, and sale of subsystems and system integration of semiconductor equipment, subsystems, and system integration of TFT-LCD, nano equipment, LED lighting, LED display product and other application product, photoelectric, communication wafer materials, and medical devices. It operates in the Americas, Taiwan, China, and internationally. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Chu-Nan, Taiwan.
